decision: A cell (forecaster x rebalance) SURVIVES iff, against buy-and-hold at the SAME mean exposure over the window, the monthly log-return difference is > 0 in design (1991-2008) AND > 0 in validate (2009-2016) with t >= 2 on 3-month blocks AND a strict majority of validate years > 0. The ENGINE question is read separately: har_ei - rv22 (paired policies, same rebalance) > 0 in validate at t >= 2. The exposure constant c is set on DESIGN dates only (mean exposure 1 there); HAR coefficients are fitted on design decision dates whose target window ends by 2008-12-31. 2017-2024 is read last, as description.
